sloka: सा त्वं भव सुविस्रब्धा अनुमानैः सुखोदयैः ।अहतौ पश्य काकुत्स्थौ स्नेहादेतद् ब्रवीमि ते ।। ६.४८.२९ ।।।।
transliteration: sā tvaṁ bhava suvisrabdhā anumānaiḥ sukhodayaiḥ ।ahatau paśya kākutsthau snehādetad bravīmi te ।। 6.48.29 ।।।।

translations.english: "I have not uttered untruth earlier nor shall I do now. Indeed, you have found entry into my mind being a woman of good disposition."
